terra.problem: The line says God kept His people safe during the plagues generally. The cited verses specifically say Goshen was spared the swarms of flies and the hail; they do not say it was spared every plague.
“Joseph invites his family” is about Goshen, but the passage does not say Joseph gave the invitation there.
“Pharaoh lets them settle” is about Goshen, but the passage does not say the conversation with Pharaoh took place there.
“No flies in Goshen” describes God’s promise, but the passage does not say where He made it. The promised absence of flies is the event connected to Goshen.
